description: Read, set or clear the webhook where a brand's alerts are POSTed the minute the cron writes them (owner/admin to change it): JSON body {event: brand.alerts, project, alerts[], radar_url}, header X-VH-Signature = sha256=<hex HMAC-SHA256 of the raw body with the secret returned here>. Answer 2xx within 8 s; no retry (alerts stay readable). url null clears it.

url.description: https URL on a public host to set; null to clear; omit to read.

name: viralhunt_brand_webhook
